high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "haitzpaintz." The post features a man sitting on the floor in front of several large paintings of horses. The man appears to be relaxed, with his legs crossed and hands resting on his knees. He is wearing a white t-shirt, brown overalls, and black shoes. The paintings behind him are displayed on easels and the wall. There are at least five horse portraits, each with different styles and colors, ranging from dark browns to lighter shades.
